# Foundations

Every scope answers the same five questions. This is the answer that sets each scope's values; open a scope for all five, its tokens and its specimen.

| Scope | Values | Why |
| --- | --- | --- |
| [Typography](./typography.md) | Large | Large text is readable for more people. |
| [Color](./color.md) | Balanced | Strong but not loud color. |
| [Spacing](./spacing.md) | Spacious | Space lowers effort and mis-taps. |
| [Shape](./shape.md) | Slightly rounded | Clear, slightly rounded controls. |
| [Elevation](./elevation.md) | No shadows | No shadows; borders do the work. |
| [Motion](./motion.md) | Moderate | Moderate speed is easy to follow. |
| [Iconography](./iconography.md) | Larger than the text | Larger icons are easier to see. |
| [Theming](./theming.md) | Light and dark | Light and dark ship as standard; both hold AAA text. |
| [Accessibility](./accessibility.md) | Large | Large targets for tremor and touch. |
| [Naming](./naming.md) | Lowercase words in paths | Lowercase paths read the same everywhere. |
| [Voice and tone](./voice.md) | Plain and direct | Every sentence is easy to read on the first try. |
| [Components](./components.md) | Only when the meaning changes | One clear way to do each thing. |
